The '''''Shrike''''' was a [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="CatCW" /> Like other [[Starship/Legends|ships]] of its class, the ''Shrike'' was 1,600 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length<ref name="DB" /> and manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

{{RPGseed}}
During a patrol just outside of the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]], it encountered the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] vessel ''[[Boolarg]]'', owned by the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gaber Rollobad]]. The ''Shrike'' ordered the ''Boorlag'' to prepare to be boarded, but because the ship was carrying illegal goods, Rollobad attempted to outrun the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. Rollobad ultimately failed to escape, and the ''Boolarg'' was shot down by the ''Shrike''{{'s}} complement of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]]. Rollobad escaped in a [[Escape pod/Legends|life pod]] and landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. After encountering a group of other individuals on the planet, Rollobad falsely claimed that he was forced to flee his ship due to a [[Power plant/Legends|power plant]] overload, rather than explain the role of the ''Shrike''.<ref name="CatCW" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Shrike'' was mentioned in a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure seed in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="CatCW" />
